intent: The inspector's number-entry primitive: a numeric field with drag-scrub, keyboard step, a mixed (multi-select) state, and an optional keyframe affordance.
use_when: Entering or nudging a number in the inspector (x, y, w, h, opacity, rotation).
You need drag-to-scrub plus typed entry on one field.
dont_use_when: A bounded value with a track — use Slider or Dial.

tokens.note: Binds to DS tokens; Input.tsx carries a hardcoded default color elsewhere in the file, so this is not claimed tokensOnly.

a11y.keyboard: Arrow = ±step, larger step with a modifier; the label is a horizontal drag-scrub surface.
a11y.label: ariaLabel when the visible label is on the owning row.
